title: Hash Include Directive
description: Include header files using the preprocessor
explanation: #include inserts the contents of another file into the current translation unit.

title: Hash Define Macro
description: Define a preprocessor macro constant
explanation: #define creates a macro — a compile-time text replacement. Prefer const/constexpr for constants.

title: Function Like Macro
description: Define a macro that takes arguments
explanation: Function-like macros mimic functions but require careful parenthesis for correctness.

title: Include Guards
description: Prevent multiple inclusions of the same header
explanation: Include guards prevent double-inclusion errors like redefinition of classes.

title: Ifdef Else Endif Conditional Compilation
description: Conditionally compile code using preprocessor directives
code:
#define DEBUG_MODE

#ifdef DEBUG_MODE
    cout << "Debug: variable = " << x << '\n';
#endif

#ifndef RELEASE_BUILD
    // Additional debug checks
#endif

// Platform detection:
#ifdef _WIN32
    #include <windows.h>
#elif defined(__linux__)
    #include <unistd.h>
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
    #include <TargetConditionals.h>
#else
    #error "Unsupported platform"
#endif

// Compiler detection:
#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
    #define LIKELY(x)   __builtin_expect(!!(x), 1)
    #define UNLIKELY(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)
#else
    #define LIKELY(x)   (x)
    #define UNLIKELY(x) (x)
#endif
explanation: Conditional compilation includes or excludes code based on preprocessor conditions.

title: Hash If Preprocessor Expression
description: Complex preprocessor conditionals with arithmetic expressions
explanation: #if evaluates integer expressions and defined() checks at compile time.

title: Pragma Directive
description: Compiler-specific instructions using #pragma
explanation: #pragma provides compiler-specific features and controls. #pragma once is the most portable.

title: Hash And Hash Hash Operators
description: Stringify (#) and token-pasting (##) preprocessor operators
explanation: # converts macro arguments to string literals; ## concatenates tokens in the output.

title: Predefined Macros
description: Standard predefined preprocessor macros
explanation: Predefined macros provide compile-time information about the source file and compilation environment.

title: Varargs Macro
description: Macro with variable number of arguments
explanation: Variadic macros accept any number of arguments, useful for logging and debug utilities.

title: Namespace Declaration
description: Declare a named scope to organize code and prevent name collisions
explanation: Namespaces organize code and prevent name collisions between different libraries or modules.

title: Nested Namespaces
description: Create nested namespace hierarchies
explanation: Nested namespaces create logical hierarchies. C++17 allows compact syntax with ::.

title: Using Declaration
description: Bring names from a namespace into the current scope
explanation: Using declarations bring specific names or entire namespaces into scope.

title: Anonymous Namespace
description: Create file-local scope equivalent to static linkage
explanation: Anonymous namespaces give all contents internal linkage, scoped to a single translation unit.

title: Inline Namespace
description: Inline namespace makes its members part of the parent namespace (C++11)
explanation: Inline namespace members are imported into the parent namespace, useful for API versioning.

title: Static Storage Class
description: Use static for persistent variables and internal linkage
explanation: Static gives variables static storage duration (lifetime = program lifetime) and/or internal linkage.

title: Extern Storage Class
description: Declare a variable defined in another translation unit
explanation: extern declares a variable without defining it, telling the linker to resolve it from another translation unit.

title: Mutabl Storage Class
description: Allow modification of a member variable in const methods
explanation: mutable allows const methods to modify specific member variables, useful for caching and thread safety.

title: Thread Local Storage Class
description: Declare variables with thread-local storage duration (C++11)
explanation: thread_local gives each thread its own instance. Combined with static for per-thread class data.

title: Static Cast
description: Compile-time type conversion between compatible types
explanation: static_cast performs compile-time checked conversions. It's safer than C-style casts and self-documenting.

title: Dynamic Cast
description: Runtime-checked downcast for polymorphic types
explanation: dynamic_cast performs runtime type checking using RTTI. Requires at least one virtual function in the base class.

title: Reinterpret Cast
description: Convert between unrelated types by reinterpreting the bit pattern
explanation: reinterpret_cast reinterprets the underlying bit pattern as a different type — maximum power, minimum safety.

title: Const Cast
description: Add or remove const/volatile qualification
explanation: const_cast adds or removes const/volatile. Only safe when removing const from something that was originally non-const.

title: C Style Cast
description: Old C-style type conversion — avoid in modern C++
explanation: C-style casts combine multiple cast operations silently. Prefer C++ named casts for safety and clarity.

title: Bit Cast (C++20)
description: Reinterpret the bit pattern of one type as another (C++20)
explanation: bit_cast provides safe, constexpr-friendly type punning without undefined behavior.

title: Enum Declaration Plain
description: Declare an unscoped enumeration (traditional C++ enum)
explanation: Plain enums create named integer constants. Prefer enum class (scoped enums) in modern C++.

title: Assert Macro
description: Runtime assertion for debugging invariants
explanation: assert() checks invariants at runtime in debug builds. static_assert checks invariants at compile time.

title: Line And Error Directives
description: Control line numbering and generate compile-time errors
explanation: #error stops compilation with a message. #line changes the reported file/line for diagnostics.
